notes: Manual allows any analog sensors; the circuit image shows three force-sensing resistors (FSRs), so fsr parts are used.
Each FSR forms a voltage divider with a 10k resistor: 5V rail -> FSR -> junction (to A0/A1/A2) -> 10k -> GND rail.

Breadboard hole names follow the catalogue convention (rows a-e = bank 't'). In the image the a-e half is drawn at the bottom and the rails are drawn top (tp/tn) and bottom (bp/bn); positive rail is the red-line row, negative the black-line row.
Column and rail-hole numbers are estimated from pixel positions: sensor columns 6, 16, 24; the two rail-to-rail jumpers at columns 28 (black) and 29 (red).
Resistor value prop is given as 10000 (10k ohm).
The FSR images show three drawn legs but the FSR part has two ports; the blue lead goes to the sense junction and the red lead to the + rail.
Arduino is shown unpowered by USB in the image; no USB cable is included. GND wire goes to the second GND pin (GND.2).
